description: This Java class defines a custom Liquibase change set for creating 'discontinue' orders in the OpenMRS system. It reads discontinued orders from the database, constructs new order entries marked as discontinued, and inserts them into the 'orders' table in batches. Implements necessary transaction management and error handling.
